description: This file defines the InOperator class, which implements filter and SQL operators for 'in' comparisons within the SuiteCRM JSON API filtering system. It includes methods for generating filter tags, SQL operators, validating operators, and formatting SQL operands.

classes.name: InOperator
classes.description: A class representing the 'in' comparison operator for filtering and SQL generation in SuiteCRM's JSON API.

methods.name: toFilterOperator
methods.description: Returns the filter operator tag for 'in'.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Validates that the operator is a string and checks its validity via parent class.

methods.name: totalOperands
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of operands (255).

methods.name: toSqlOperands
methods.description: Formats the operands array into a SQL-compatible string enclosed in parentheses.
